description: A studio's full filmography by name or AniList studio ID. Returns all titles the studio produced, sortable by year or score, with format, status, and episode count. Provide "name" for a name-based search, or "id" for direct lookup by AniList studio ID.

id.description: AniList studio ID for direct lookup. More precise than name search. Send either id or name, not both.

name.description: Studio name to search for, e.g. "MAPPA", "Kyoto Animation", "ufotable". Trimmed; blank counts as absent. Send either name or id, not both.

per_page.description: Studio credits per page. Maximum 25, AniList's page size for a studio's titles.

sort.description: Sort order for the filmography. POPULARITY_DESC: most popular first (default). SCORE_DESC: highest-scored first. START_DATE_DESC: newest first. START_DATE: oldest first (release chronology).

name: anime_get_studio

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_identifier`: Neither a non-blank name nor an id is provided. `conflicting_inputs`: Both id and a non-blank name are provided. `not_found`: Neither name search nor ID lookup returns a result on AniList. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

filmography.description: Studio filmography, one row per distinct title within this page. AniList pages the studio's credits rather than its titles, so a title credited on two pages can appear on both.

is_main_studio.description: True when this studio is a main studio on the title; false for a co-credit only.

season.description: Broadcast season label, e.g. "FALL 2023", or null.

has_next_page.description: Whether more pages are available. Drives pagination; stop when false.

is_animation_studio.description: True when this is classified as an animation studio.

notice.description: Set when the page is past the end of the filmography: says to request a lower page.

studio_site_url.description: AniList studio page URL, or null.

totalCount.description: Exact number of distinct titles, set only when the whole filmography fits on page 1 (0 for an empty first page). Use has_next_page to paginate.

total_titles.description: Exact number of distinct titles, present only when the whole filmography fits on page 1 (0 for an empty first page). Null whenever the filmography spans more than one page.

title: Anime Get Studio
